The closing OCR year MDCCLXXVII is retained, while normalized date remains null. All substantive body text is in order and own margins are wholly separate LF blocks. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
